title: Continuity of the biased minus-probability polynomial
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f$ be a Boolean-valued function on the sign cube $\\{-1,1\\}^n$. For each real $p$, form the polynomial $(1-P_f(1-2p))/2$, where $P_f(\\mu)=\\sum_{S\\subseteq\\{1,\\ldots,n\\}}\\mu^{|S|}\\widehat f(S)$ and $\\widehat f(S)$ is the uniform Fourier coefficient of the real-valued sign representation of $f$. This function of $p$ is continuous on $\\bbr$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
